# GHOST L0 content and TLV vectors (Phase 9 design faza9-dm.md §7.1). Generated and checked by
# client-core/dm/tests/vectors.rs::dm_content_vectors; an independent implementation replays it.
#
#   l0 = version(1) = 01 || kind(1) || message_id(16) || author_minute(4) || minute_index(2)
#        || timer_code(1) || timer_version(4) || flags(1) || quote_ref(0 or 16)
#        || body_len(4) || body || ext_len(2) || ext
#   ext = TLVs  type(u16) || len(u16) || value,  strictly ascending type, each at most once
#   kind: 01 TEXT, 02 TIMER_SET, 03 REACTION, 04 CONTROL; 05 MEDIA is refused in Phase 9.
#   flags bit 0 = a quote reference follows; every other bit must be 0.
#   Author time exists only as author_minute, a u32 count of minutes: seconds are zero by type.
#
# [refuse_*] sections carry an `input` that must be refused, with the result code it must give.
# [class_*] sections carry the S21.11 point 3 class boundaries: the bucket is a function of the
# body length alone, so the same body gives the same bucket with and without a quote and with and
# without a pending classical TLV. They record lengths and the L0 digest, not the whole record.

[slack_rule]
# R-C5: a PQ TLV rides only when it fits in what is left of the bucket the body
# length alone already chose, so the bucket never depends on a PQ TLV.
pq_key_tlv_bytes = 1232
seal_root_pq_tlv_bytes = 1170
fits_4096_pq_key_body_1148 = 1
fits_4096_pq_key_body_1149 = 0
fits_4096_seal_root_pq_body_1210 = 1
fits_4096_seal_root_pq_body_1211 = 0

[ext_reserve]
# S21.11 point 3: L_class = 52 + |body| + EXT_RESERVE and the bucket is the smallest
# b with L_class <= b - o_max, computed from the body length alone. A sender refuses
# classical TLVs beyond ext_reserve; receivers accept up to max_ext (2560).
ext_reserve = 160
max_ext = 2560
l0_fixed_with_quote = 52
classical_tlv_refused_at = 161
